### ① Derived judgments

1. **What widens.** One new published subpath, `./namespaces/marketplace` (`ui/packages/i18n/package.json:41-45`, the `./namespaces/studio` shape beside it), and the API behind it in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/index.ts`: `MarketplaceCatalogue` (:81), `MARKETPLACE_NAMESPACE` (:84), `MARKETPLACE_NAMESPACE_PROBE_KEY` (:91), `MARKETPLACE_LANGUAGE_CODES` (:113), `resolveMarketplaceLanguage()` (:125), `isMarketplaceCatalogueLoaded()` (:158), `loadMarketplaceCatalogue()` (:168), `MarketplaceNamespaceState` (:261-270), `useMarketplaceNamespace()` (:296). Ten partial packs `namespaces/marketplace/CODE.ts`, each `const en = { marketplace: {…} }` with `export default` (en.ts:12-13), the shape the AST gates read. Correct: a widening on `@object-ui/i18n` only; `@object-ui/app-shell`'s entry gains nothing (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts:279-280` still exports only the two pages; `MarketplaceNamespaceGate` and `marketplaceFrameHolding` are not on the entry).
2. **What narrows.** The root entry's `en` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/index.ts:123`, a re-export of `./locales/en.js`), the type `TranslationKeys = typeof en` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts:5752`, re-exported at `src/index.ts:41`, `src/i18n.ts:336`, `locales/registry.ts:247`, `locales/index.ts:56`, and by `ui/packages/react/src/index.ts:111`), and each pack module `@object-ui/i18n/locales/CODE` (`en.ts` diff: 245 changed lines, the `marketplace` group cut to 19 leaves — `installedAdditiveNote`, `notLoaded.*`, `action.{uninstall,uninstalling,details}`, `uninstall.{confirm,confirmNotLoaded,successInList,successNotLoaded}`, `install.dependencyMissing.*`, `install.protocolCheckSkipped.*` at en.ts:4928-4962; the nine other packs cut the same way, e.g. zh.ts). A `t('marketplace.…')` call keeps compiling (its key is `string`); what narrows is the object a direct reader indexes and the type a consumer derives from it. Correct reading, and the changeset names exactly these three.
3. **The `@object-ui/i18n/locales` door (the surface the claim did not list).** `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/index.ts:35-54` now statically imports the ten packs AND the ten catalogues, and :89-98 hands out each language as `complete(pack, catalogue)` (:67-84, a deep merge that throws on a leaf defined in both, :75-77); `builtInLocales` (:104-115) and `registerBuiltInLocales()` (:156-160) carry the complete objects. Judged **right**: the module's own header names its two purposes — the parity/drift suites and an app that wants every catalogue resident — and both need every string; and `registerBuiltInLocales()` registering the namespace group is what lets `residentCatalogue()` (namespaces/marketplace/index.ts:145-155) serve a page without a fetch. Its key set is identical to main's (main's `locales/index.ts:20-29` re-exported the pack modules), so this door neither widens nor narrows. Two consequences a reader should know, neither a finding: (a) `builtInLocales.en` is a new object, no longer identical to the entry `en` or to `@object-ui/i18n/locales/en` — no reader in the tree compares identity (head grep of `builtInLocales` outside i18n: console tests indexing `.zh`, `.en`, `.auth` …); (b) a duplicate key now throws at evaluation of the door, which the three gates in item 7 refuse first. **It does not change the narrowing**: the root `en`, `TranslationKeys` and `./locales/CODE` still lose the subtree, and the door is the migration target the changeset names.
4. **The arm.** `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` on the PR body and in the changeset (line 8), `Metadata-protocol: none` on both. `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` defines `yes (narrowing)` as "a diff that widens one surface and narrows another. Both facts are true and both are read" — exactly items 1 and 2. Correct spelling; `no (narrowing)` would deny the new subpath, `yes (widening)` would hide the cut.
5. **Pages and frame.** `MarketplacePage.tsx:313-320` and `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx:162-169` wrap their bodies in `MarketplaceNamespaceGate` (gate: skeleton `MarketplaceResolving` while `loading`, resident `console.errors.somethingWentWrong` / `tryAgain` with `retry` when `failed`, children when `ready`, `MarketplaceNamespaceGate.tsx:39-57, 59-75`). `MarketplaceResolving.tsx` reads no `t()` (grep), so the loading frame is copy-free. `SampleDataLeaveBanner.tsx:49-50` asks `useMarketplaceFrameHolding()` before raising the leave banner, and the gate sets that flag in a layout effect of the commit that swaps the body out (:42-44), which runs before that commit's passive cleanups — the ordering the guard relies on holds. Exported component signatures unchanged.
6. **Ceilings and the registry.** `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS['i18n-locale-en']` stays `60_000` (`ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs:2239`); the diff to that file is the ten-line comment at :2229-2238 only; `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` is not in the diff; `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/registry.ts` is not in the 41 files; pack file names unchanged. All as the card requires. The 59,951 → 57,010 reading and "same 103 eager chunk names" are the dev's builds (PR body, Acceptance notes); not re-measured here.
7. **Gates still see the moved keys.** `collectEnKeys` reads `locales/en.ts` plus `PACK_NAMESPACE_DIRS/en.ts` (`ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs:1329-1360, 1364-1426`) and throws on a leaf in both or a leaf-vs-group clash (:1405-1413); the dead-keys report excludes hits inside `PACK_DEFINITION_DIRS` (`check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs:468-474, 670`); `readPacks` merges each language's partial pack and throws on a duplicate (`check-i18n-en-drift.mjs:366-403`); `all-locales-key-parity` walks `builtInLocales`, which is complete (item 3). The namespace `en.ts` is optional only when absent (:1358), in which case its keys are simply undefined and a call site asking for one is reported `missing-key` (gate test "reports a call site asking for a namespace key the namespace no longer defines") — nothing is weakened. The `i18n-en-drift-baseline.json` waiver of `marketplace.searchPlaceholder` is now read where the key lives (`check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts:662-665` moved to `readPacks`).
8. **Chunking.** `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts:1238-1277`: `i18n-ns-marketplace` (loader, `includeDependenciesRecursively: false`), ten `i18n-ns-marketplace-CODE` groups, `marketplace-namespace-gate` (frame + holding flag, `includeDependenciesRecursively: false`), with the two measured reasons in the comment. `check-eager-locale-catalogues.mjs` keys on `CATALOGUE_CHUNK_PREFIX = 'i18n-locale-'` (:108), so the new `i18n-ns-marketplace-*` names are outside its census and cannot trip it.

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/i18n: patch`, `@object-ui/app-shell: patch` (changeset :2-3). Correct under AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3: `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`, and "a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition". Nothing a metadata author writes changes.
- The body carries `**BREAKING**` (changeset :20) naming the three narrowed surfaces (entry `en`, `TranslationKeys`, `@object-ui/i18n/locales/CODE`) and the migration in prose: a component outside the marketplace pages calls `useMarketplaceNamespace()` and renders once `ready`; code reading the catalogue objects reads `@object-ui/i18n/locales`. No `FROM → TO` arrow — deliberate and consistent: ADR-0087 D7 says `runtime-interface-only` inherits the `no-migration-prescription` refusal, so an arrow-shaped prescription would refuse the marker. No export is removed or renamed, so no retirement row is owed; the one-line fix is present.
- ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (runtime-interface-only ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts#TranslationKeys)` (changeset :11). Against D7's four predicates at head: (1) resolves — `export type TranslationKeys = typeof en` at `locales/en.ts:5752`; (2) `en.ts` is not `*.zod.ts`, not under `packages/spec/src/contracts/`, not an object definition (`metadataSurfaceKind`, gate :2823-2830); (3) not a `z.input`/`z.infer` projection; (4) its references at head (`i18n.ts:14`, `registry.ts:54`, `locales/index.ts:56`, `react/src/index.ts:111`) are none of them metadata surfaces. The other categories do not fit: `type-surface-only` is for a declared type moving off `any` (ADR-0087 addendum 2026-08-30), `runtime-export-retired` for a retired export — here `en`, the type and the `./locales/*` subpaths all remain, narrower. `not-required` is the right disposition: `objectstack migrate meta` has nothing to rewrite, the compiler is the channel (the dev's reverse check, `TS2339` on `en.marketplace.title`). The dev reports the gate verified it on `origin/main`; not re-run here.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions: []` in os-dev-report 6667819073. `out_of_scope_findings`: (1) the PR body's Acceptance-notes bullet "Out of scope, observed: `i18n-ns-studio-en` is in the eager closure … while the README says the studio namespace loads with the designer" is wrong and the seat should strike it — `namespaces/studio/index.ts:33-36` imports `en` statically as the fallback every language resolves to, so that chunk is eager by design; (2) a language switch while a page is open unmounts the body behind the skeleton (half-filled install dialog lost) — a stated design choice, recorded in the PR body, accepted.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (PR `user.login`) — no login note owed.
- Size: `additions 4,338 + deletions 2,294 = 6,632` changed lines (PR object), over the 3,000 line of AGENTS.md §7(c): the landing is a human merge — an authorized APPROVED review by a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account (`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:698`: `os-zhuang`, `hotlong`) and then the owning seat lands it. Stated, not a finding. PR is still a draft at this head.
- `Skills-docs:` (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm). `git grep -n "marketplace\." origin/main -- skills/ .claude/ docs/` → 17 hits: `marketplace.zod.ts` and marketplace prose in ADR-0019/0025/0026/0028/0048, `docs/design/marketplace-publishing.md`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md`. None names a `marketplace.*` i18n key, the pack shape, or teaches that the group lives in `locales/CODE.ts`. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md:79` teaches that exporting the pack and `TranslationKeys` publishes every key — still true, and it is the rule this declaration obeys. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json:744` names `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts (marketplace load failed/unreachable)` as a dated re-read coordinate at base `fd246c22` — a record of a past reading, not teaching text; no follow-up owed. So `Skills-docs: none — REASON` is the right line. The body currently spells it `Skills-docs: none (no skills/** text names the moved keys or the pack shape)`; SKILL.md's spelling is `none — REASON`, and the reason should also cover `docs/` and `.claude/` (should-fix on the body, below).

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing against the published spec on `main`: does it take a declared capability away at a consumer, and does the pin hold every reader?

- **In-tree readers of a moved key outside the frame.** Head grep `marketplace\.[A-Za-z]` over `ui/` outside `console/marketplace/`, `locales/`, `namespaces/` and tests hits only CHANGELOGs, the i18n README, the gate scripts' docblocks and vocabulary table (`check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs:1101, 1110`) and the drift baseline. No source outside the directory spells a moved key. Doors into the directory from outside (head grep `console/marketplace/`): `app-shell/src/index.ts:279-280` (the two gated pages), `marketplaceApi.js` (`layout/AiUsageIndicator.tsx:42`, `layout/StorageUsageBanner.tsx:50`, `views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx:90`), and `MarketplaceRowActions.js`, `dependencyMissing.js`, `protocolCheckSkipped.js`, `ProtocolCheckSkippedNote.js` (`PackagesPage.tsx:91-94`). `PluginDisclosure.tsx`, whose template families `marketplace.category.*` and `marketplace.disclosure.*` are in the namespace (`namespaces/marketplace/en.ts:160, 208`), is imported only by `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx:63`, under the frame. Studio's packages page therefore renders only the 19 resident leaves; no key or English shows there.
- **The boundary test** (`marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts`) computes that census itself (:148-156), walks relative imports transitively from every ungated door (:159-168), and holds every spelled key or template head to the entry `en` (:207-219), with a lit control that it read more than 15 keys; it also pins that both pages' exported component returns a `MarketplaceNamespaceGate` element (:188-205) and that the probe key really left the pack (:221-224). It went red at the `69ab56e1` packs (dev's report). What it pins: every reader that reaches the directory by a relative import. What it does not: a file outside the directory that spells a namespace key without importing from it — none exists today, and `check-i18n-call-site-keys` would accept such a call site because the key is defined. That is the one residual (should-fix, below), not a broken consumer.
- **Ten languages, first paint, fallback.** `MARKETPLACE_LOADERS` names all ten (`namespaces/marketplace/index.ts:98-110`), pinned to `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES` by `marketplace-namespace.test.ts:106-108, 117-119`. `resolveMarketplaceLanguage` uses the registry's `matchLanguageTag` (`registry.ts:112-117`), so `zh-CN` → `zh`, and the bundle is added under `zh`, which is on i18next's resolution path for `zh-CN` as the packs already are (:198-207, 254). `catalogueTargets` always includes `en` (:204), so a leaf a translation lacks falls back to English, never a raw key. `useMarketplaceNamespace` answers `loading` until both are resident (`installResident` :240-258, :341-354) and the gate renders the copy-free skeleton, so a zh user's first frame with text is Chinese — `MarketplacePage.namespaceGate-30588.test.tsx` records every text node via a MutationObserver (:143-175) and asserts no English title/subtitle and no `marketplace.X` over the whole sequence (:178-210). `failed` is answered only when the request is not in flight (:346-349); the effect retries once per mount or language (:334-336) and the button retries on demand; the lazy test waits 50 ms and asserts one request, then two after `retry()` (:163-183) — no loop. A host's own `resources` win because `addResourceBundle(…, deep=true, overwrite=false)` (:254) and the per-instance `installed` set (:224) keeps a host-spelled key from suppressing the rest of the catalogue (lazy test case 4).
- **A key in both pack and namespace** is refused in three places (`locales/index.ts:75-77` at evaluation; `collectEnKeys`; `readPacks`) and pinned per language by `marketplace-namespace.test.ts:132-139`; the gate tests pin the refusals on fixtures (`check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts:278-293`, `check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts:494-501`).
- **Would the four tests go red on the regression they pin?** (a) `MarketplacePage.namespaceGate-30588.test.tsx`: packs alone are registered (:110-111), so with the gate removed the first frame renders `marketplace.title` raw and `:184-186` fail (dev's ablation: 2/3 and 1/3 red); case 4 (:232-275) fails without the `isFrameHolding` guard — the zh banner is raised at the switch (red before the fix). (b) `marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts` case 3 fails on any ungated key missing from the entry `en`. (c) `marketplace-namespace-lazy.test.tsx` case 1: any `ready` before the zh catalogue lands records a `zh-CN|` followed by English or a raw key entry and `:129` fails; case 5 fails on a second automatic request. (d) `marketplace-namespace.test.ts`: a static catalogue import or a template-literal loader fails `:106-115`; a copied (not cut) key fails `:138`.
- **External (npm) consumers.** A host component that reads a moved key through `t()` without the frame sees a raw key (or English after an earlier visit); the changeset says what to call. A host reading `en.marketplace.title` off the entry gets `TS2339` — the compiler channel D8 names. A host that already calls `registerBuiltInLocales()` is unaffected (complete catalogues, no fetch). This is the declared narrowing, not a hidden one.
- Observations, not findings: the catalogue fetch starts at page mount, after the route chunk has arrived — two sequential round trips on a first open; `installResident()` and `loadMarketplaceCatalogue()` run during render (store writes and a fetch start), idempotent through `given` and `inFlight` and the same shape as `useStudioCatalogue`.

Findings:
- must-fix: none.
- should-fix (1), the pin's residual: a `marketplace.*` namespace key spelled by a source outside `console/marketplace/` that imports nothing from that directory is read by no pin and is accepted by `check-i18n-call-site-keys` (the key exists in `collectEnKeys`). Follow-up, not this PR: have the call-site gate, which already knows `PACK_NAMESPACE_DIRS`, refuse a namespace key spelled outside the directories that render under the frame, or widen the boundary census to every source outside the directory.
- should-fix (2), PR body only, for the seat: strike the "Out of scope, observed" bullet on `i18n-ns-studio-en` (studio's `en` is resident by design, `namespaces/studio/index.ts:33-36`); respell the third line as `Skills-docs: none — no skills/, .claude/ or docs/ text names the moved keys or teaches the pack shape (17 hits on `marketplace.` are all `marketplace.zod.ts` and marketplace prose)`.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台首屏常驻的英文语言包里，市场页（应用市场列表和软件包详情）的文案搬进一个按需加载的 `marketplace` 命名空间，十种语言都有；打开市场页时才取，取到之前显示不带文字的骨架，不会闪英文或键名。Studio 软件包页（市场路由外）用到的 19 条英文留在常驻包里。
- 为什么改：首屏英文包 `i18n-locale-en` 的 gz 上限是 60,000 字节，main 上只剩约 63 字节，任何加英文界面文字的卡都会让 `Build & E2E UI` 变红（PR #30545、PR #30552 已被挡住）。本 PR 不抬上限，把读数从 59,951 降到 57,010，留出 2,990 字节。
- 风险与回滚：第一次打开市场页多一次按需加载；切换语言时页面先回到骨架，正在填的安装对话框会丢（PR 的 Acceptance notes 写明了取舍）。`@object-ui/i18n` 根入口导出的 `en` 和 `locales/<lang>` 包模块少了 `marketplace` 子树，属于收窄；`@object-ui/i18n/locales` 这扇“全部语言”的门仍然给出完整目录。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/index.ts`（加载器），`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplaceNamespaceGate.tsx`（页框），`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/index.ts`（完整目录的合并），`ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-namespace.test.ts packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-namespace-lazy.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.namespaceGate-30588.test.tsx`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 改动 6,632 行（41 文件，+4,338/−2,294，大部分是十个语言文件里整段搬移），超过 3,000 行线，要一位有权限的维护者（`os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong`）在 PR 上给 APPROVED review；批准后席位 ready 并挂自动合并。
- 席位意见：可合。整张卡一次交付（`Fixes`），达档契约复核 PASS 在案。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · head 17e15c7ffbcf57dc5fbe175dfc845bfbb20bb761

- **Eager and first-screen surfaces.** Head grep of `marketplace.` + letter over `ui/` outside `packages/i18n`, `console/marketplace/`, tests, scripts and prose: zero hits; over `packages/`, `apps/`, `examples/`: zero code readers of `@object-ui/i18n` (prose mentions only). Property-chain reads (`.marketplace.title` and the other moved families): zero. Doors into `console/marketplace/` from outside: the two gated pages (`app-shell/src/index.ts:279-280`), `cloudConsoleUrl` only (`layout/AiUsageIndicator.tsx:42`, `layout/StorageUsageBanner.tsx:50`), and Studio's eager `PackagesPage.tsx:90-94`. What that page can reach, read file by file: `MarketplaceRowActions.tsx` (11 keys, its one in-directory import is `./marketplaceApi.js` at :40), `dependencyMissing.ts` (6), `protocolCheckSkipped.ts` (2), `ProtocolCheckSkippedNote.tsx` (no key, no in-directory import), `marketplaceApi.ts` (no key; a type-only import of `./protocolCheckSkipped.js`): 19 keys, exactly the 19 resident leaves of item ①2. Nothing eager renders a moved key, so no raw key and no English flash on any first-load surface. `marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts:148-168, :207-219` computes this census from the sources and holds it; `MarketplacePage.namespaceGate-30588.test.tsx:143-175` records every text node a page adds and holds "never English, never a raw key" over the whole sequence for `zh-CN` and `de`, the failed-fetch path for `ar`, and the no-banner-on-switch case.
- **Ten languages, fallback, loop.** `MARKETPLACE_LOADERS` names all ten (`namespaces/marketplace/index.ts:98-110`), pinned to `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES`. `resolveMarketplaceLanguage` uses the registry's `matchLanguageTag` (`registry.ts:112-117`: exact tag, then base), so `zh-CN` is served by `zh` and the bundle is added under `zh`; `createI18n` sets `fallbackLng: 'en'` and no `load` option (`i18n.ts:250, :301`), so i18next's default resolution path `zh-CN → zh → en` reaches both. `catalogueTargets` (:202-207) always includes `en`, so a leaf a translation lacks falls back to English, never to a raw key. `installResident` (:240-258) adds the bundle deep and without overwrite, so a host's `resources` win, and the per-instance `installed` set (:224) keeps a host-spelled key from suppressing the rest. `failed` is answered only when nothing is in flight (:346-349); the mount/language effect retries once (:334-336), the button on demand: no loop. In production the registry holds packs alone (`preloadBootstrapLocale`), so `residentCatalogue()` (:145-155) finds no `marketplace.title` and fetches; a host that called `registerBuiltInLocales()` is served without a fetch.
- **Would the pins go red on the regression they guard?** Gate removed from a page: the first frame renders `marketplace.title` raw, `namespaceGate-30588.test.tsx:184-186` fails (dev's ablation 2/3 and 1/3 red, consistent with the code). Holding guard removed: case 4 raises the zh banner on the switch (:233-275). A key copied, not cut: `marketplace-namespace.test.ts:138` fails, and `locales/index.ts:75-77`, `collectEnKeys` and `readPacks` all throw. A static catalogue import or a template-literal loader: `:106-115` fails. The boundary test went red at the `69ab56e1` packs (dev's report) and its lit control requires more than 15 keys read.
- **External (npm) consumers.** A host reading `en.marketplace.title` off the entry gets `TS2339`; a host component reading a moved key through `t()` without the frame sees a raw key or, after an earlier visit, English — the changeset says what to call; a host that registers the all-ten door is unaffected. This is the declared narrowing, not a hidden one; no in-tree consumer loses anything.
- **Semantics kept.** The all-ten door, parity, drift and call-site gates all still see every key; `registerBuiltInLocales()` still makes every string resident; text unchanged in all ten languages (item ①3). The capability the card declares — moved text displayed in all ten languages with a loading state and no key or English flash — is delivered in the tree, not only claimed.
